title: desync.rs in-crate test unused binding breaks clippy -D warnings
description: valid_beacon_resets_missed_counter_in_recovering (rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs:638, from 86c69c827b) has let st = fsm.on_beacon(true, false); whose binding is shadowed before ever being read — cargo check -p lichen-core --tests emits unused_variables warning, so cargo clippy -p lichen-core --all-targets -- -D warnings fails. Fix: make the middle call a bare statement (matches the existing bare fsm.on_beacon pattern a few lines up in the same test; result is intentionally unchecked there, final call is asserted). Test-only, zero behavior change. Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-psxx verification pass.
